infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Goki reads your heart rate, steps, sleep recovery, and workout telemetry from Apple Health to verify training effort for Ironman Mode and award character XP and loot.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Goki saves your completed training sessions and verified Ironman workout telemetry to Apple Health so your fitness history stays in sync.

web.name: Goki: Fitness RPG
web.description: Turn real-world workouts into holistic 7-stat character progression, boss raids, and hardware-verified Ironman rewards.
